The '''Bramior system''' was situated in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Bramior star]], a large [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], and the [[rogue moon]] [[Rove]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the luxury [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Cal-class battleship|starship]] ''[[Cal Ambre]]'' maintained a permanent [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] near the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field. As part of the [[Bombarde]] game, the ''Cal Ambre'' would use its [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass driver cannon]] to shoot asteroids at Rove's surface, with the game's participants aboard the [[Kumauri Battleship|starship]] observing the proceedings and betting on which section of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] would be impacted.

Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Retter Lewis]] operated aboard the ''Cal Ambre'' a respectable artifact [[Merchant/Legends|dealership]], [[Callia's]], which was regularly visited by prominent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;affiliated individuals. He also used the business as a cover for running a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] transportation network. The network provided secure passage for Rebel agents on the run in addition to defecting Imperial dignitaries, with such fugitives often being smuggled onto or off the ''Cal Ambre'' disguised as artifact shipments.

==Description==
The Bramior system was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Bramior star]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a large [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. In addition, eons before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Gravity/Legends|captured]] the [[rogue moon]] [[Rove]].<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
[[File:Cal_ambre.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Cal Ambre'' maintained a permanent orbit in the Bramior system.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the three-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long [[Cal-class battleship|''Cal''-class battleship]] ''[[Cal Ambre]]'', which had been converted into a luxury [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], maintained a permanent orbit in the Bramior [[Star system/Legends|system]], at the edge of its [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field. The main attraction of the ''Cal Ambre'' was the [[Bombarde]] game, which involved the [[Kumauri Battleship|starship]] using its [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass driver cannon]] to shoot asteroids&mdash;drawn in via the use of its [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]]&mdash;at randomly generated coordinates on Rove's surface and people aboard the vessel betting on which section of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] would be impacted, with the bettors observing the proceedings from an observation gallery.<ref name="CRO" />

During the Galactic Civil War, [[Retter Lewis]], an artifact [[Merchant/Legends|dealer]] based out of the [[Callia's]] shop aboard the ''Cal Ambre'', and his two permanent employees, [[Graff Teiras]] and [[Halacc Demior]], secretly operated one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] largest covert transportation networks. The network provided safe passage to Rebel agents on the run as well as defecting important [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who were moved from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to Alliance bases or [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] more remote regions. Often those individuals were smuggled onto or off the ''Cal Ambre'' in secret, disguised as Callia's artifact shipments. Eventually, Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] noted the transportation operation in the Bramior system in an entry dedicated to Lewis that was part of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives.<ref name="CRO" />

==Inhabitants==
The ''Cal Ambre'', which held a permanent orbit in the Bramior system, had a crew of 2,150 individuals and a passenger capacity of nine thousand people. At times, starships, including [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], were present near the vessel, with many [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|ferries]] traveling between it and the other ships. A [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] of the Galactic Empire, able to arrive within fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] of an alert from the ''Cal Ambre'', was present in the star system at all times in order to provide security to the gambling ship. The Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was usually on hand during the arrival and departure of [[Luxury liner/Legends|liners]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="CRO" />

The ''Cal Ambre'' experienced a constant influx of Imperial dignitaries, with [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], business officials, [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], and other prominent individuals routinely visiting Callia's. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]], [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], and [[Professor/Legends|professors]] also frequented the establishment. Imperial agents regularly obtained [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-attuned artifacts from the shop, with those items subsequently being transported either to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CRO" />&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Empire<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;or to one of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] secret storehouses.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bramior system was created by [[Paul Sudlow]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, an illustration by [[Doug Shuler]] depicted a view of the system.<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
